cases.purpose: Independently establish real ipset absent on candidate PATH and verify rules and kernel set snapshots. Separate exact ipset body from iptables rules; guest comparator rejection canaries.
cases.oracle: Real pinned iptables/ip6tables/iptables-save executables and real ipset save/test in a fresh guest network namespace. A private PATH contains symlinks only to the named real tools; no mocked backend output.
cases.comparison: Exact success marker; independent PATH and builtin checks, complete rules comparison, rule presence/absence, exact save section and positive/negative kernel membership. Setup failure is not a product pass.
